rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person in charge, including a school-district administrator when no more specific official title is intended.

example.english: The superintendent said that funding would be provided next term to improve facilities at several schools.
example.traditional: 教育局主管話下個學期會撥款改善幾間學校嘅設施。

rows.note: Use this for the person who looks after a residential building and its facilities, rather than a general supervisor.

example.english: The superintendent said the water would be shut off tomorrow morning and told everyone to store some water in advance.
example.traditional: 大廈管理員話聽日朝早會停水，叫大家預先儲定啲水。

rows.note: Use this specifically for the Hong Kong police rank between chief inspector and chief superintendent.

example.english: The superintendent personally went to the scene to direct the operation.
example.traditional: 嗰位警司親自到場指揮今次行動。
